respondents: State rep. by its Inspector of Police, PODANUR Police Station, Coimbatore District

judgment_text:
Prayer : Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying to issue a writ of habeas corpus to call for the entire records relating to the petitioner's son detention under Tamil Nadu Act 14 of 1982 vide detention order, dated 20.08.2025 on the file of the second respondent herein made in proceedings memo C.No. 141/G/IS/2015, quash the same as illegal and consequently direct the respondents herein to produce the petitioner's son namely A. Sharukhan @ Perukan, S/o. Abdul Farook, aged 28 years before this Court and set the petitioner's son at liberty from detention, now the petitioner's son detained at Central Prison, Coimbatore.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

Dr Anita Sumanth, J.:—

Mr. RMuniyapparaj, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, states that nothing survives in this matter as the detention order in C.No. 141/G/IS/2015 dated 20.08.2025 passed against the detenu has been revoked by the Government by its order in G.O. Rt.No. 6245 Home, Prohibition and Excise (XII) Department, dated 29.09.2025, recording which, this Habeas Corpus Petition is closed. No costs.
